title.narrative: Optimizing HIV Investments for Impact - Nigeria (01-Jul-2019-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Nigeria, HIV, Family Health International (FHI360) (FHI 360)This program has the following goals: To reduce the mortality and morbidity due to HIV/AIDS in Nigeria. To signigficantly reduce the incidence of new HIV infections by 2021. The objectives of this program are: To ensure that 90% of PLHIVs in Nigeria know their HIV status by 2021.. To provide ART to at least 90% of PLHIVs that know their HIV status by 2021.. To achieve 90% viral suppression among PLHIVs on ART by 2021.. To ensure that 90% of key and vulnerable population have access to HIV prevention interventions by 2021.. To increase the percentage of all HIV postive pregnant and breastfeeding mothers receiving ART to 95% by 2021.
